# Wonder & Workflow

> Wonder & Workflow is the public name of Wonder&Workflow LLC. We help overloaded owner-operators improve how work gets done, with a practical next step and people still in control.

## Who we help

Owner-led field and service shops with 1-50 people: hospitality (restaurants, bars, hotels, catering), retail, construction and trades, field and home services (cleaning, landscaping, detailing, restoration, moving), and signs, print, and production. Typical stuck points are invoices in the wrong hands, inventory that walks, and work that still waits on the owner. Not promoted as a fit for law, accounting, or clinical practices. Not for all-in-one field-app shopping or a full-time fractional COO embed.

## What we do

Map how work gets done, choose the simplest suitable solution (a clearer procedure, an existing tool, automation, or useful AI), test it, and leave the team able to run it. Engagements start with one real path of work and expand only after that result is understood. The Operations Fit Review diagnoses structure and ownership. You may not need another tool.

## Start here

Primary public CTA: https://wonderworkflow.com/assessment

Complete the operations assessment (contact details and save). Then book a complimentary 30-minute Operations Fit Review (a 30-minute business operations review) on the embedded calendar.

## Contact

operations@wonderworkflow.com

Use email for questions, privacy requests, or an existing inquiry. Email is not the Operations Fit Review booking path.

## Out of scope

Law, CPA, and clinical work. We are not a marketing agency. Formal legal, certification, and regulated-industry opinions need an appropriately qualified specialist.

## Next steps

Complimentary Operations Fit Review, then a paid diagnostic scoped after the review, then implementation, then optional support. Software and vendor costs stay separate.

## Pricing

No public pricing. The Operations Fit Review is complimentary. Paid diagnostic or implementation work is quoted in writing after that review. Do not invent package prices from this file.
